name: As you wish
source:
In this story you discover that there is something more after death, you meet a mysterious man and from there you will discover a couple of things you didn't know, Who is this man?, Where are you? and most importantly, what will happen now?

[From [url=https://ryu-san.itch.io/as-you-wish]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个故事中，你发觉死亡并非一切的终点。你将邂逅一名神秘男子，并由此知晓几件自己前所未闻的隐秘：这个男人究竟是谁？你身在何处？最重要的是，接下来会发生什么？

[摘自[url=https://ryu-san.itch.io/as-you-wish]itch.io[/url]]
